rules.notes: The 2026 Meursault specification authorizes Premier Cru with the listed climat names. This positive rule is limited to the white Premier Cru variant because every seeded Meursault Premier Cru climat is valid for white wine; the red climat color matrix remains separately fail-closed.
The current Chambolle-Musigny specification authorizes Premier Cru wines to carry the listed climat name. Generic lieux-dits are not promoted by this rule.

All 17 listed Puligny-Montrachet Premier Cru climats are authorized for white wine. The official color matrix has three white-only climats, so a broad red climat rule is deliberately not created until site-specific exclusions are modeled.
The current 2026 Volnay specification authorizes Premier Cru wines to carry the listed climat names. Generic lieux-dits remain outside this positive rule.
The published Saint-Aubin specification explicitly permits the listed Premier Cru climat names for both white and red still wines. Generic lieux-dits are not promoted by this rule.
The current Pouilly-Fuissé specification authorizes the 22 listed Premier Cru climat names.

The 2025 Mercurey specification authorizes 33 Premier Cru climats for white and red wine. This rule promotes the 32 official climat identities currently present in the project seed; Clos du Château de Montaigu remains a tracked site-registry coverage gap.
The current Givry specification authorizes the listed Premier Cru climat names for white and red wine.
The current Montagny specification authorizes the 49 listed Premier Cru climat names for white wine.
